posts.title: Our servers were fine. They just couldn't reach each other.
posts.description: On 20 October, Hetzner's private network started losing the messages our servers send each other. Every server was fine. And now we have a story on how an emergency fix turned into our main network.

posts.description: Customers increasingly forward us AI-generated diagnoses of their own problems. Most of it is confidently wrong − and confidence was never the same thing as correctness.
